systems.system: National Civil Registration Authority national registry
systems.country_label: national registry (integrated civil registration, National Civil Registration Act 2016)
systems.tiers: national; the document says nearly 75% of the population has a verified digital and biometric record with NCRA (as of November 2019), each citizen to be issued a National Identification Number, and gives no office or district tier

note: The strategy describes NCRA's registry only as a biometric population record and the platform for the national digital identity; it says nothing of how or where births or deaths are registered, and notes generally that government data collection is manual, paper-based and not integrated.
